title: Consecutive Numbers
description: Find all numbers that appear at least 3 times consecutively in the Logs table. Use the LAG and LEAD window functions.
hints: Use LAG(num, 1) and LAG(num, 2) to look back at previous rows
Filter WHERE num = LAG(num, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AND num = LAG(num, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id)
SELECT DISTINCT num to avoid duplicates
